title: When Disaster Strikes, Could AI Help? Q&A with Jessica Jensen
summary_en: Disasters are more frequent, more severe, and more costly. Pressure is mounting on emergency managers and the organizations that support them. Senior policy researcher Jessica Jensen discusses how artificial intelligence could help carry some of that burden.
title_cn: When Disaster Strikes, Could AI Help? Q&A with Jessica Jensen

title: Countering Model Distillation: Limits and Alternatives
summary_en: Artificial intelligence model distillation (training new models on outputs of more capable ones) could affect U.S. frontier model advantage. New policy tools could augment such technical countermeasures as raising costs or reducing model quality.
title_cn: Countering Model Distillation: Limits and Alternatives

title: A Standardized Framework for Assessing High-Risk Life Sciences Research: Defining Objective Criteria That Can Facilitate Expert and AI Reviews of Dangerous Gain-of-Function Research
summary_en: Recent federal policies establish funding prohibitions and review requirements for certain high-risk life sciences research. The authors advise that federal agencies adopt an objective decisionmaking framework for dangerous gain-of-function research.
title_cn: A Standardized Framework for Assessing High-Risk Life Sciences Research: Defining Objective Criteria That Can Facilitate Expert and AI Reviews of Dangerous Gain-of-Function Research

title: Operational reliance on AI in supply chains and emerging insurance risks
summary_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming embedded in supply chains. This report examines how that changes operational reliance, resilience, and insurance risk across logistics, transport, and warehousing.
title_cn: Operational reliance on AI in supply chains and emerging insurance risks
